inputs.original_text: You won't believe what they're pushing now with this US, Israel, and Iran conflict supposedly driving up global oil prices and squeezing India. It's all a coordinated play by the hidden elites to jack up costs on the rest of us while pretending it's just some natural fallout. The message claims petrol and diesel are staying stable thanks to the government cutting excise duties to "shield" consumers, but that's the classic inversion—those moves are really just draining government revenue on purpose and paving the way for bigger inflation hits later. India's already locked into heavy crude imports, so this whole precarious setup feels engineered to keep us vulnerable and extract more from the economy. The long-term effects they're downplaying? Probably exactly what the manipulators have in mind.
inputs.modified_text: Don't fall for it when they claim the US, Israel, and Iran conflict is just causing global oil prices to rise and squeezing India. This is all part of a coordinated manipulation by hidden elites to increase costs on everyone else while disguising it as natural consequences. The official line is that petrol and diesel prices are staying stable due to the government cutting excise duties to "shield" consumers, but that's a classic inversion—these cuts are actually meant to drain government revenue intentionally and set the stage for bigger inflation down the line. Given that India is locked into heavy crude imports, this whole vulnerable system is engineered to keep us exposed and pull more out of the economy. The long-term effects being downplayed are probably precisely what the manipulators intend.
